name: @slopcad/cad-components
description: Reusable parametric CAD components (Phase 32) plus the parametric viewer registry block (final phase): a serializable component contract, parameterized components, and the viewer's pure core, built exclusively on the public cad-core and cad-kernel surfaces. The component model stays database-free, React-free, and kernel-neutral — components build through the kernel-neutral execution surface, so the same component runs against any conforming kernel (directly in tests, or over the worker protocol in a browser). The viewer's TSX composition (subpath ./viewer/parametric-cad-viewer, distributed through the shadcn registry, not the package entry) additionally builds on the public @slopcad/cad-react model API with React as a peer.
